description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named EmployeeReportsSearchFilterParams used for filtering employee report data. It extends a base date range search filter and includes properties and methods for filtering by employee number, project ID, activity ID, and timesheet inclusion criteria. It also specifies allowed sorting fields and constants related to timesheet approval states.

classes.name: EmployeeReportsSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for filtering employee reports, including employee number, project ID, activity ID, and timesheet inclusion options, extending date range filtering capabilities.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for filtering.

methods.name: getProjectId
methods.description: Retrieves the project ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setProjectId
methods.description: Sets the project ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getActivityId
methods.description: Retrieves the activity ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setActivityId
methods.description: Sets the activity ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getIncludeTimesheets
methods.description: Returns the timesheet inclusion filter setting.

methods.name: setIncludeTimesheets
methods.description: Sets the timesheet inclusion filter; validates input against allowed options.
